title: OCI VCN Rejected Traffic Spike
description: Alert-ready aggregation for a source address producing more than 100 rejected VCN flow records in the ten-minute scheduled-search window. This preserves the threshold behavior of the referenced Splunk alert while using OCI Log Analytics display fields.
query: 'Log Source' = 'SOC VCN Flow Logs' and 'Action' = 'REJECT' | stats count as RejectedFlows, earliest(Time) as FirstSeen, latest(Time) as LastSeen by 'Source IP' | where RejectedFlows > 100 | sort -RejectedFlows
